title: Chat Two
description: Adds a new chatbar that's completely isolated and unrelated to the real (censored) one
body:
# Chat 2 (before GTAVI)

**This mod adds one GUI screen, the Chat 2.**

**Chat 2 shows a text field that you can type into, and upon clicking the "Send" button, it will send it as a message to all players.**

**This screen is completely unrelated to the real chat menu, meaning no change to the game will prevent this one from working.**

**The only thing that would prevent it from working, is if the whole chat display was blocked. If that's the case, I will update this mod to add my own display.**

![Screenshot of the gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lgnC6RKS/images/a733f47464f407c6fe3d46536abbf3e8bf818348.png)

(Other versions coming in the future. Like 1.21.4 and 1.20.1 Also let me know what versions you'd like to see and I'll let you know if it's doable.)
